test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition in the following sentence.

They are cutting down trees ________ the tune of 1000 tons a month.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "**to**" is used to describe a measurement or extent in this context ("**to the tune of**").
 
• The phrase "**to the tune of**" means "amounting to" or "in the magnitude of."
